The '''jungle wampa''' was a [[Color/Legends|brown]]-furred [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] that lived in temperate jungle climates, such as the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. Rishi's [[Horizon Island]] hosted a population of jungle wampas during the era of the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" /> The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] and her clan kept a large jungle wampa that they named ''[[Kyramla Gemas'rugam]]''&mdash;which meant "Deadly Hairball" in [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']]&mdash;on [[Tracyn Island]] on Rishi.<ref name="Blood">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=flashpoint|Blood Hunt}}</ref>
